svg.aria-label: A systems language that compiles itself.
svg.title: 机会翼游 JHYY — A systems language that compiles itself.

g.text: JHYY is a statically typed, expression-oriented systems language.
The compiler is written in the language itself — and the backend is a
self-written amd64 emitter. No LLVM, no vendored QBE, no garbage collector.
